subject: Mathematics
chapterName: Chapter 1: Applications of Matrices and Determinants

topics.title: Row Echelon Form
topics.description: Introduction to elementary row operations, leading entries, pivots, and transforming matrices into Row Echelon Form.

topics.title: Rank of a Matrix
topics.description: Definition of matrix rank, counting non-zero rows in echelon form, and evaluating rank properties of square and rectangular matrices.

topics.title: Inverse of a Non-Singular Matrix
topics.description: Determinants, adjugate matrices, and computing inverse matrix A⁻¹ = adj(A) / det(A) for non-singular matrices.

topics.title: Applications of Matrices - Solving Systems
topics.description: Solving linear systems of equations using Matrix Inversion Method (X = A⁻¹B) and Cramer's Rule.

topics.title: Gaussian Elimination Method
topics.description: Applying Gaussian elimination with back-substitution to solve systems of linear equations systematically.

topics.title: Consistency of Non-Homogeneous Equations
topics.description: Rouché-Capelli theorem, comparing rank(A) and rank([A|B]) to determine unique, infinitely many, or no solutions.

topics.title: Homogeneous Linear Equations
topics.description: Analyzing AX = 0 systems, trivial solutions vs non-trivial solutions, and condition det(A) = 0.
